"text": "Outreach purpose: collect current estate planning documents for financial planning review.\n\nSuggested message:\n\nHello [Client or Contact Name],\n\nWe are updating [Client/Household Name]'s estate planning records so the financial plan, beneficiary designations, and account titling can be reviewed consistently.
